subject: Add moving average to a chartSerie [quantmod]

messages.author: 4e6060fd7b80ee80
messages.subject: Add moving average to a chartSerie [quantmod]
parts:
Hey all,

My app plot the time series of stock prices and now I am trying to add a time series line to it, in server.R I put down:

if (!require(quantmod)) {
  stop("This app requires the quantmod package. To install it, run 'install.packages(\"quantmod\")'.\n")
}

# Download data for a stock if needed, and return the data
require_symbol <- function(symbol, envir = parent.frame()) {
  if (is.null(envir[[symbol]])) {
    envir[[symbol]] <- getSymbols(symbol, auto.assign = FALSE)
  }
 
  envir[[symbol]]
}


shinyServer(function(input, output) {
 
  # Create an environment for storing data
  symbol_env <- new.env()
 
  # Make a chart for a symbol, with the settings from the inputs
  make_chart <- function(symbol) {
    symbol_data <- require_symbol(symbol, symbol_env)
   
    chartSeries(symbol_data,
                name      = symbol,
                type      = input$chart_type,
                subset    = paste("last", input$time_num, input$time_unit),
                log.scale = input$log_y,
                theme     = "black")
   
    addSMA(n = 10, on = 1, with.col = Cl, overlay = TRUE, col = "brown")
  }
 
  output$plot_stock <- renderPlot({ make_chart(input$variable) })

})

However, no MA line has been added to the plot. Anyone knows how to resolve this?

Thank you,

Su

I solved this problem adding plot=FALSE to the chartSeries call and printing the object returned by addSMA:

  chartSeries(symbol_data,..., plot=FALSE)
  print(addSMA(n=10, ...)
